critique: The delivered result is an all-alphabet, same-class minimax bracket rather than a complete shrinking-radius frontier. In the residual regime \(b\ll u\ll1\) and \(b\ll\sigma^2\ll1\), the proved upper scale is \(M^2\{b+\min(u,\sigma^2)\}\), while the converse reaches only \(M^2(b+\sigma^2u)\); for \(d=n\) and \(\sigma^2=1/\log(en)\), their ratio diverges logarithmically. The note therefore does not determine whether a radius-coupled fuzzy construction yields the stronger converse or a different estimator attains the product benchmark. The framing consistently calls the result a bracket and leaves `oeq:shrinking-radius-frontier` open, so it does not stale-overclaim a uniformly matched frontier.
